verdict.rationale: The product documents its own bulk-upload process for equity promises (docs-4), so it has a real but narrow bulk operation. Nothing shows bulk editing, bulk grant issuance or bulk actions across other item types, and probes found no OpenAPI spec or llms.txt for programmatic bulk automation. missing for 10: bulk operations beyond equity-promise upload (e.g. bulk grants, edits or approvals), API/programmatic bulk endpoints, detail on the bulk process's scope and limits, independent corroboration.
